description_en: Creates a custom image from a deployed WUYING instance to quickly create more instances with the same configuration, avoiding repetitive environment setup each time
description_zh: 通过已部署好的无影实例创建自定义镜像，以便快速创建更多相同配置的无影实例，避免每次创建时重复配置实例环境
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center create-image-by-instance --image-name test --description my_test_image_v1.0 --instance-id ws-0buj1s9gm000000 --sub-instance-id p-0cc7s3n1l00000 --instance-type WuyingServer --auto-clean-userdata false --disk-type ALL --biz-type 1 --product-type WuyingServer --tag-list Value=example-string Key=example-string --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageByInstance

parameters.help_en: The WUYING instance ID. The instance can be a Cloud Desktop instance or a workstation instance. To ensure data consistency in the image, stop the instance before creating the image
parameters.help_zh: 无影实例ID。该实例可以是云桌面实例，工作站实例。为了保障镜像中的数据数据一致性， 建议将实例关机之后再发起镜像制作
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The sub-instance ID. This parameter does not apply to Cloud Desktop scenarios. In workstation scenarios, specify the persistent session ID to identify a specific instance
parameters.help_zh: 子实例ID，云电脑场景不涉及。工作站场景，需要传入持久会话ID，确保定位到一个具体的实例
parameters.name: sub_instance_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter applies only to Cloud Desktop instances. Specifies whether to clear user personal data. If set to true, the created image clears data in all directories under C:\Users except Administrator and Public
parameters.help_zh:
该参数目前仅适用于实例类型是云桌面场景。
是否清除用户个人数据。若设为true，制作的镜像会清除C:\Users目录下除Administrator、Public之外的其他目录的数据
parameters.name: auto_clean_userdata

parameters.help_en: The type of disk data included in the image. By default, both the system cloud disk and data cloud disk of the instance are included
parameters.help_zh: 镜像中包含的磁盘数据种类，默认包含实例的系统盘和数据盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: product_type
